scope: Proposed acceptance requirements; no planned test name asserts a current implementation

requirements.title: Specimen-bounded fidelity claim
requirements.statement: Every fidelity claim identifies specimen(s), gestures, observation conditions, reference and exclusions.
requirements.evidence: Signed scope, exclusion table, source-to-claim trace

requirements.title: Admissible source ledger
requirements.statement: Every physical value has units, uncertainty/provenance, measurement conditions and permission status; conflicting values remain quarantined.
requirements.evidence: Ledger, source copies or stable citations, quarantined-value tests

requirements.title: Reproducible independent oracle
requirements.statement: Each numerical change has an independent analytic, manufactured, or converged comparator and immutable fixture identity.
requirements.evidence: Derivation, frozen input hashes, raw error curves

requirements.title: Cross-platform evidence isolation
requirements.statement: Every introduced runnable subsystem has a portable test path; platform/host/hardware qualifications are recorded separately.
requirements.evidence: Three OS run links and artifact manifests, explicit skipped environments

requirements.title: Linear spatial convergence
requirements.statement: Fixed-end and movable-interface spatial operators converge to independent reference responses and preserve dimensionally correct force injection.
requirements.evidence: Order plots, boundary eigenanalysis, discrete-work identity

requirements.title: Energy-stable time stepping
requirements.statement: A time step declares its temporal levels, valid parameter domain, discrete energy and failure handling; unforced passive fixtures cannot create unexplained energy.
requirements.evidence: Amplification derivation, energy/work residual traces, unstable counterexamples

requirements.title: Stiffness and loss validity
requirements.statement: Bending dispersion and frequency-dependent loss are separated experimentally and numerically and reproduce their limiting cases.
requirements.evidence: Mode tables, decay fits, zero-stiffness and zero-loss limits

requirements.title: Transverse and longitudinal degrees of freedom
requirements.statement: An added polarization or nonlinear strain mechanism includes its physical coupling terms, units and work ledger.
requirements.evidence: Full equations, manufactured coupled solution, energy partition

requirements.title: Finite nail/flesh excitation
requirements.statement: Excitation force depends on a documented relative motion/contact law with physically defined engagement and release; no audio clip is the excitation primitive.
requirements.evidence: Contact law, force-displacement loop, high-speed observations, held-out plucks
requirements.status_note: Synthetic power-law nail contact with documented engagement and force/travel release is implemented in setar::instrument; contact.nail_passivity and contact.release_convergence are partial synthetic checks.

requirements.title: Excitation reproducibility
requirements.statement: Gesture events, initial state, contact coefficients and random seeds uniquely reproduce measured or synthetic pluck response.
requirements.evidence: Gesture manifest, variation envelope, deterministic replay WAV and state traces
requirements.status_note: Deterministic synthetic gesture replay is implemented and tested in one build; measured pluck reproduction is not.

requirements.title: Moving fret/finger contacts
requirements.statement: Fretting changes constraint/contact states without erasing global string energy; externally performed work and dissipation are accounted for.
requirements.evidence: Nonpenetration/residual plots, energy/work record, afterlength decay
requirements.status_note: Finger pad, fret obstacle and stick-spring contacts with ledger-booked work are implemented on persistent strings; partial synthetic checks only.

requirements.title: Physical retuning transition
requirements.statement: Tension and position changes update coefficients and state by an explicitly documented physical or nonphysical transition policy.
requirements.evidence: Control trajectory, boundary-work estimate, transition-error analysis

requirements.title: Reference-specimen geometry
requirements.statement: Every geometric primitive is traceable to a single specimen, coordinate frame, calibrated procedure and uncertainty interval.
requirements.evidence: Landmarks, scaled meshes, scan logs, uncertainty propagation

requirements.title: Physically admissible materials
requirements.statement: Mass/stiffness tensors obey documented symmetry and positivity; published contradictions must not enter accepted coefficients.
requirements.evidence: Orthotropic compliance tests, raw methods and quarantine disposition
requirements.status_note: Orthotropic reciprocity/positivity screening exists for synthetic plate constants only; no specimen or published tensor has passed.

requirements.title: Independent structural reference
requirements.statement: Structural FEM treats boundary conditions, material orientation and mesh convergence explicitly before body modes are retained.
requirements.evidence: Mesh, weak form, orientation, eigenvalue/FRF convergence plots

requirements.title: Measured bridge mobility
requirements.statement: The body interface includes calibrated multi-axis mobility or impedance with observable reciprocity/passivity and uncertainty.
requirements.evidence: Complex FRF, excitation/response positions, coherence and sensor correction

requirements.title: Stable model reduction
requirements.statement: Modal or rational reduction preserves the declared frequency-range input/output behavior and passive port semantics.
requirements.evidence: Reference and reduced FRFs, error-vs-cost, out-of-fit modes

requirements.title: Power-conjugate bridge connection
requirements.statement: Strings and body share co-located equal/opposite forces and compatible velocity levels; no unexplained sample delay is allowed.
requirements.evidence: Discrete joint work equation, time-level table, passive fixture traces
requirements.status_note: The prototype solves string-bridge springs and contacts simultaneously with the body; the original two-mass oracles and new synthetic ledgers are partial checks.

requirements.title: Sympathetic cross-string motion
requirements.statement: Persistent unstruck-string motion arises through modeled shared structure, not an independently mixed sample layer.
requirements.evidence: Reciprocity test, initial-state table, held-out cross-FRF
requirements.status_note: Sympathetic motion arises only through the shared synthetic modal body; detuning and measured transfer remain open.

requirements.title: Cavity/structure boundary consistency
requirements.statement: Cavity pressure and structural velocity couple through reciprocal surface work operators and validated boundary conditions.
requirements.evidence: Acoustic mesh, boundary quadrature, coupled-energy plots

requirements.title: Calibrated observation model
requirements.statement: Predicted microphone pressure distinguishes radiation/directivity, instrument position, microphones, room and post-processing.
requirements.evidence: Mic calibration, angle/distance sweep, de-embedded room or documented room model

requirements.title: Four physical string histories
requirements.statement: The full instrument has four persistent string states and shared structural loading; host note events do not allocate independent physical strings.
requirements.evidence: State snapshots, controlled repeated plucks, sympathetic decay
requirements.status_note: Instrument keeps four persistent string states and a shared body; host note events map to gestures, never to new strings.

requirements.title: Practitioner-reviewed gesture grammar
requirements.statement: Idiomatic Iranian setar tuning, ornament, touch, stopping and damping gestures are modeled and reviewed by identified practitioners.
requirements.evidence: Consent-controlled annotations, review ledger, before/after examples

requirements.title: Identifiability before fitting
requirements.statement: Sensitivity, correlations and practical identifiability are examined before optimizing each parameter family.
requirements.evidence: Jacobian/SVD, posterior or confidence intervals, alternative parameter fits

requirements.title: Held-out predictive calibration
requirements.statement: Optimizers cannot see the validation split; parameters and metrics are registered before held-out evaluation.
requirements.evidence: Dataset hashes, split manifest, optimization trace, holdout error intervals

requirements.title: Bounded audio callback
requirements.statement: Rendering performs no locks, allocation, file I/O or unbounded search; its worst-case work follows accepted capacity limits.
requirements.evidence: Call-tree audit, allocation traces, worst-case configuration profiles
requirements.status_note: process() is designed allocation-free with fixed capacities and an allocation-hook test; no measured worst-case timing.

requirements.title: Reference-versus-runtime parity
requirements.statement: Every reduced/multirate/fast-math path is compared against an independent offline oracle in physical metrics over a defined domain.
requirements.evidence: Error-vs-cost Pareto, spectral/phase/contact errors, versioned tolerances

requirements.title: Safe asset publication and diagnostics
requirements.statement: Prepared state is validated off-thread; audio adopts complete immutable assets at defined boundaries without unbounded destruction; telemetry never races live state.
requirements.evidence: Ownership diagram, fault injection, race and reclamation traces

requirements.title: JUCE/VST3 adapter isolation
requirements.statement: JUCE owns host adaptation only; physical solving is in a portable C++20 engine and builds headlessly without JUCE.
requirements.evidence: Dependency graph, build manifests, plugin scan and validator log

requirements.title: Event and state compatibility
requirements.statement: The host adapter preserves sample offsets, event identity/order, immutable parameter IDs, schema versions and rollback-safe state loading.
requirements.evidence: Host/standalone differential renders, migration fixtures, fuzz corpus

requirements.title: Lifecycle resilience
requirements.statement: Zero and variable blocks, bus changes, sample-rate changes, suspend/resume, bypass and offline mode have explicit safe semantics.
requirements.evidence: Steinberg validator output, host screenshots/logs, failure reproduction

requirements.title: Musician controls reflect physics
requirements.statement: The UI distinguishes measured physical controls, inferred parameters, gestures, observation gain and unsupported transforms.
requirements.evidence: Control dictionary, practitioner's review, keyboard and screen-reader record

requirements.title: Reproducible visual diagnostics
requirements.statement: Waveform, mode, energy, gesture/contact, FRF and profiling plots expose units, provenance, revision and synthetic/measured status.
requirements.evidence: Captured real UI, plot data, viewport/fonts, perceptual and structural diff reports

requirements.title: Platform/host qualification map
requirements.statement: Product claims enumerate actually tested OS architecture, DAW/host version, plugin format, sample rate, block sizes and event cases.
requirements.evidence: Versioned execution matrix, real runner outputs, acknowledged exclusions

requirements.title: Fault recovery and degradation
requirements.statement: Invalid inputs, event overflow, CPU deadline miss and solver failure retain audible containment and observable diagnostics without claiming valid physics.
requirements.evidence: Failure injections, counters, recovery and stuck-note traces

requirements.title: Blind acoustic validation
requirements.statement: Acoustic metrics use preregistered held-out specimens/gestures, matched levels, calibrated observation, confidence intervals and declared reference noise floors.
requirements.evidence: Frozen preregistration, permitted raw recordings, paired metrics and intervals

requirements.title: Perceptual and playable fidelity
requirements.statement: Blind listeners and practicing setar players separately assess sound identity, dynamics, gesture response and musical usability within a defined experiment.
requirements.evidence: Counterbalanced protocol, consent, randomization, effect sizes and limitations

requirements.title: Rights and dependency clearance
requirements.statement: Distribution requires explicit reviewed license choice, redistributable data rights and pinned third-party artifacts.
requirements.evidence: License decision, source attribution, permitted package manifest

requirements.title: Reproducible release identity
requirements.statement: Every distributed build identifies code, dependencies, model assets, parameters, validator evidence and known exclusions.
requirements.evidence: SBOM, hashes, build logs, notarization/signing evidence if applicable

requirements.title: Scientific regression governance
requirements.statement: New models and calibration revisions preserve historical benchmark reproducibility, explicit migrations and the right to reject regressions.
requirements.evidence: Change-impact analysis, old/new reference outcomes and superseded ADRs

requirements.title: Sustained provenance/access
requirements.statement: Maintainers can reconstruct every accepted claim from legally retained inputs or identify and withdraw inaccessible evidence.
requirements.evidence: Source/consent ledger, archive hashes, claim withdrawal procedure
